blocks.text: Data events provide information on the activities performed on or within AWS data stores, such as reading or writing to an S3 bucket, GetObject API operations, etc. DSPM supports ingestion of data events to analyze the activity logs.

blocks.heading: Managing Data Events Configuration for an Organization

blocks.text: To manage data events configuration for an organization:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Cloud Accounts.
The Cloud Accounts page appears.
On the Cloud Accounts page, click the required cloud account.
Click Manage, and then select Manage Data Events.
See image.
On the Manage Data Events page, click the toggle to enable or disable data events:
Enable
Under Storage Information, enter the following details:
CloudTrail Type: Select the OrgCloudTrail checkbox, if it is an organization CloudTrail.
CloudTrail Bucket Name: Enter the S3 bucket name where the CloudTrail events are logged.
Prefix (Optional): Enter the prefix specified in the CloudTrail bucket path, if any.
Bucket Account ID: Enter the AWS account ID where the CloudTrail S3 bucket is present.
See image.
On the Apply Changes page:
Select the template type (CloudFormation or Terraform).
Download the Data Events template and run it on the account where the specified CloudTrail S3 bucket is present.
See image.
Disable
Click Next.
On the Apply Changes page, click Done.
When disabled, DSPM stops collecting data events from the S3 bucket.

blocks.heading: Managing Data Events Configuration for Single or Multiple Accounts

blocks.text: To manage data events configuration for single or multiple accounts:

blocks.item: Go to Data Security > DSPM > Cloud Accounts.
The Cloud Accounts page appears.
On the Cloud Accounts page, click the required cloud account and then select the Accounts tab.
Choose one of the following options:
To manage data events for a single account:
Click the Actions icon for the account you want to update data events on, then select Manage Data Events.
See image.
To manage data events for multiple accounts:
Select the checkboxes for the required accounts.
From the highlighted options, select Manage Data Events.
See image.
The Manage Data Events page appears.
On the Manage Data Events page, click the toggle to enable or disable data events.
Enable
Under Storage Information, enter the following details:
CloudTrail Type: Select the OrgCloudTrail checkbox, if it is an organization CloudTrail.
CloudTrail Bucket Name: Enter the S3 bucket name where the CloudTrail events are logged.
Prefix (Optional): Enter the prefix specified in the CloudTrail bucket path, if any.
Bucket Account ID: Enter the AWS account ID where the CloudTrail S3 bucket is present.
See image.
On the Apply Changes page:
Select the template type (CloudFormation or Terraform).
Download the Data Events template and run it on the account where the specified CloudTrail S3 bucket is present.
See image.
Disable
Click Next.
On the Apply Changes page, click Done.
See image.
